neutral_alpb.decision_reason: The default OBC-II paired MAE gain is only about 0.00235 kcal/mol and its bootstrap interval crosses zero.
neutral_alpb.derivative_capability: Analytical in this neutral domain: scale the same GB polar energy and force by one constant.
neutral_alpb.electrostatic_size_term: The Q^2/A term vanishes for the declared neutral domain.
neutral_alpb.formula: For neutral Q=0: G_ALPB,polar = G_GB,polar/(1 + alpha*epsilon_in/epsilon_out)
